generic.Defined scope/population: Population is all invoices marked Approved with no open exceptions in the AP queue
generic.In-scope period: Current payment run cycle through today's batch cutoff
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each batch line has vendor, amount, payment method, and due date populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Batch invoice count and dollar total match the AP aging summary
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Batch file and AP aging summary snapshot saved with the batch-run timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Invoices on hold (dispute, missing W-9, duplicate) logged as excluded with a reason
generic.Test population: Sample of 15 invoices drawn from the assembled payment run batch
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if 100% of sampled invoices show Approved status with no open hold flag
generic.Exception handling path: Any held or non-approved invoice found in the batch routes back to AP for removal
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Batch is accepted when count and total tie to the AP aging summary with zero holds
generic.Evidence location: AP payment run batch folder in the ERP with the attached aging summary export

steps.title: Filter the AP invoice queue to Approved, non-held invoices
sop: Open the AP invoice queue in the ERP.
Filter status to Approved and exclude items flagged on hold.
Confirm the filtered list excludes dispute, missing-W-9, and duplicate flags.
Done when the filtered queue shows only approved, unheld invoices.
verify: Spot-check 5 filtered invoices for Approved status and no hold flag.
Pass when all 5 show Approved status with no hold flag.

steps.title: Group invoices into the batch by payment method and due date
sop: Sort filtered invoices by payment method (ACH/check/wire).
Sub-group each method by vendor terms due date.
Assign the grouped invoices to the new payment run batch in the ERP.
Done when every filtered invoice is assigned to a payment-method sub-batch.
verify: Confirm each sub-batch contains only one payment method.
Pass when no sub-batch mixes payment methods.

steps.title: Reconcile batch count and total to the AP aging summary
sop: Pull the AP aging summary report for the current cycle from the ERP.
Compare the batch invoice count and dollar total to the aging summary.
Investigate and correct any mismatch before proceeding.
Done when batch count and total match the aging summary exactly.
verify: Re-run the comparison after any correction.
Pass when batch count and total equal the aging summary figures.

steps.title: Exclude held invoices from the batch
sop: Review the exception list for dispute, missing-W-9, or duplicate holds.
Remove any held invoice found in the batch.
Log the exclusion reason against each removed invoice.
Done when no held invoice remains in the batch.
verify: Query the batch for any invoice with an active hold flag.
Pass when the query returns zero held invoices.

steps.title: Attach the aging summary to the batch record
sop: Attach the AP aging summary export to the batch record in the ERP.
Note the batch-assembly timestamp and preparer name.
Done when the batch record carries the aging summary attachment and timestamp.
verify: Open the batch record and confirm the attachment is present.
Pass when the aging summary attachment and timestamp are both visible.

steps.title: Route the assembled batch for release approval
sop: Submit the assembled batch to the release-approval queue in the ERP.
Notify Finance Operations Analyst the batch is ready for review.
Done when the batch status shows Pending Release Approval.
verify: Confirm the batch status field reads Pending Release Approval.
Pass when the status is correct and the batch appears in the approval queue.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is all invoices pending GL coding before posting to the ledger
generic.In-scope period: Invoices received in the current AP processing cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each invoice carries a GL account, cost center, and project/WBS code
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of coded invoices matches the count pulled from the coding queue
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Coding screen entries saved with preparer name and coding date
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Invoices flagged for closed or restricted GL accounts logged with the correction taken
generic.Test population: Sample of 15 coded invoices drawn from the current cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if 100% of sampled invoices map to an open, unrestricted GL account
generic.Exception handling path: Any invoice coded to a closed or restricted account is corrected before posting
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Coding is accepted when GL account, cost center, and project code all validate against masters
generic.Evidence location: AP invoice coding screen history in the ERP with the chart-of-accounts mapping table

steps.title: Open the invoice coding screen in the ERP
sop: Open the AP invoice coding queue in the ERP.
Select the next uncoded invoice.
Done when the invoice coding screen is loaded for entry.
verify: Confirm the correct invoice number is loaded on screen.
Pass when the loaded invoice matches the queue selection.

steps.title: Enter GL account, cost center, and project code
sop: Enter the GL account per the vendor's spend category.
Enter the cost center and project/WBS code from the requester's PO or request.
Done when all three coding fields are populated on the invoice.
verify: Reopen the invoice and confirm all three fields display.
Pass when GL account, cost center, and project code are all populated.

steps.title: Cross-check the GL account against the chart-of-accounts mapping table
sop: Look up the vendor's spend category in the chart-of-accounts mapping table.
Compare the mapped GL account to the account entered on the invoice.
Done when the entered account matches the mapping table.
verify: Confirm the mapping table lookup result matches the invoice.
Pass when the two accounts are identical.

steps.title: Confirm cost center matches the requester's department
sop: Look up the requester's department in the org hierarchy.
Compare the org-hierarchy department to the cost center coded on the invoice.
Done when the coded cost center matches the requester's department.
verify: Re-check the org-hierarchy lookup against the coded cost center.
Pass when the two match with no discrepancy.

steps.title: Flag and correct invoices coded to closed or restricted accounts
sop: Run the closed/restricted-account validation check on the invoice.
Correct the GL account if the check flags a closed or restricted account.
Done when no invoice remains coded to a closed or restricted account.
verify: Re-run the validation check after correction.
Pass when the check returns zero closed or restricted accounts.

steps.title: Release the coded invoice for posting
sop: Save the completed coding entry in the ERP.
Route the invoice to the next posting step.
Done when the invoice status shows Coded and is queued for posting.
verify: Confirm the invoice status field reads Coded.
Pass when the status is correct and the invoice appears in the posting queue.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is all invoices exceeding the single-approver spend authority threshold
generic.In-scope period: Invoices pending approval in the current AP workflow cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each over-threshold invoice shows two distinct approver names and timestamps
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of over-threshold invoices matches the approval workflow queue count
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Second-approval evidence saved in the ERP workflow log with approver and timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Invoices missing second approval within the SLA window logged with escalation date
generic.Test population: Sample of 10 over-threshold invoices from the current cycle
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if 100% of sampled invoices show two distinct recorded approvals
generic.Exception handling path: Any invoice missing a timely second approval escalates to Finance leadership
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Approval is accepted when two distinct, timestamped approvals exist before payment
generic.Evidence location: ERP approval workflow log filtered to over-threshold invoices for the period

steps.title: Identify invoices exceeding the single-approver threshold
sop: Open the approval workflow queue in the ERP.
Filter invoices whose amount exceeds the single-approver spend authority limit.
Done when the over-threshold invoice list is generated.
verify: Spot-check 3 flagged invoices against the published threshold table.
Pass when all 3 exceed the single-approver limit.

steps.title: Route the invoice to the designated second approver
sop: Look up the second approver in the delegation-of-authority matrix.
Route the invoice to that approver in the ERP workflow.
Done when the invoice shows a pending second-approval task.
verify: Confirm the routed approver matches the DOA matrix entry.
Pass when the assigned approver is the correct DOA-matrix approver.

steps.title: Capture the second approval with name and timestamp
sop: Review the invoice details in the ERP approval workflow.
Approve or reject with electronic signature.
Done when the workflow log records approver name and timestamp.
verify: Open the workflow log for the invoice.
Pass when a distinct second approver name and timestamp are recorded.

steps.title: Escalate invoices missing timely second approval
sop: Identify invoices past the SLA window without a second approval.
Escalate each to Finance leadership with the invoice and elapsed time noted.
Done when every SLA-breaching invoice has a logged escalation.
verify: Check the escalation log against the SLA-breach list.
Pass when every breaching invoice has a recorded escalation.

steps.title: Confirm the invoice cannot post without two approvals
sop: Attempt to post an over-threshold invoice with only one approval recorded.
Confirm the ERP blocks posting until the second approval is captured.
Done when the system-enforced block is verified for the tested invoice.
verify: Review the system block message for the test invoice.
Pass when posting is blocked until both approvals exist.

steps.title: Release the fully approved invoice to the payment schedule
sop: Confirm both approvals are recorded on the invoice.
Move the invoice to the scheduled-for-payment status.
Done when the invoice is queued for the next payment run.
verify: Confirm the invoice status reads Scheduled.
Pass when the status is correct and both approvals remain visible.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is all vendor invoices received and pending AP system entry
generic.In-scope period: Invoices received during the current processing cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each booked invoice has vendor, invoice number, invoice date, and amount populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of booked invoices matches the intake register count for the day

generic.Exception handling path: Any invoice failing the duplicate check or vendor status routes to a hold queue
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Invoice is accepted when booked with vendor, amount, image, and a passed duplicate check
generic.Evidence location: AP invoice entry screen record in the ERP with the attached scanned image

steps.title: Open the AP invoice entry screen
sop: Open the invoice entry screen in the ERP.
Select the next invoice from the intake register.
Done when the entry screen is ready for the selected invoice.
verify: Confirm the loaded invoice matches the intake register entry.
Pass when the correct invoice is loaded.

steps.title: Enter vendor, invoice number, date, and amount
sop: Enter the vendor name, invoice number, invoice date, and amount.
Save the entry before attaching the image.
Done when all four core fields are populated and saved.
verify: Reopen the saved record and confirm all four fields display.
Pass when vendor, number, date, and amount all match the source invoice.

steps.title: Attach the scanned invoice image
sop: Scan or retrieve the invoice image from the intake system.
Attach the image to the AP record before submitting for matching.
Done when the image attachment is visible on the record.
verify: Open the record and confirm the image renders.
Pass when the attached image is legible and matches the entered invoice.

steps.title: Confirm vendor is active and not on the do-not-pay list
sop: Look up the vendor in the vendor master record.
Confirm the vendor status is Active and not flagged do-not-pay.
Done when vendor status is confirmed clear.
verify: Re-check the vendor master status field.
Pass when the vendor shows Active with no do-not-pay flag.

steps.title: Run the duplicate-invoice check
sop: Run the duplicate-invoice check in the ERP against vendor and invoice number.
Investigate any hit before proceeding.
Done when the invoice passes the duplicate check or the hit is resolved.
verify: Confirm the duplicate-check result field shows Clear.
Pass when the invoice shows a Clear duplicate-check result.

steps.title: Submit the invoice for matching
sop: Confirm all entry fields, image, vendor status, and duplicate check are complete.
Submit the invoice from entry into the matching workflow.
Done when the invoice status changes to Booked.
verify: Confirm the invoice status field reads Booked.
Pass when the status is Booked with all supporting checks complete.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is all vendor invoices arriving via mail, email, and the e-invoicing portal
generic.In-scope period: Invoices received during the current business day

generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of logged invoices matches the count of physical and electronic invoices received

generic.Exception handling path: Any invoice missing a PO number or approver name is returned to the requester
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Intake is accepted when every invoice is logged with a received date and tracking number
generic.Evidence location: Invoice intake register in the ERP or SharePoint invoice log

steps.title: Collect invoices from the AP mailbox, scanned mail, and e-invoicing portal
sop: Check the AP mailbox, scanned-mail folder, and e-invoicing portal for new invoices.
Consolidate the day's invoices into a single intake batch.
Done when all channels are checked and invoices consolidated.
verify: Confirm each channel was checked for the day.
Pass when all three channels show zero unprocessed items remaining.

steps.title: Log each invoice into the intake register
sop: Enter vendor, invoice number, and source channel into the intake register.
Save the entry for each invoice in the batch.
Done when every invoice in the batch has an intake register row.
verify: Count the register rows against the batch count.
Pass when register row count equals the batch invoice count.

steps.title: Timestamp each invoice with the received date
sop: Stamp each invoice with the date received in the intake register.
Confirm the timestamp starts the payment-terms clock.
Done when every invoice carries a received-date timestamp.
verify: Spot-check 5 invoices for a populated received-date field.
Pass when all 5 show a received-date timestamp.

steps.title: Route invoices missing a PO number or approver name
sop: Identify invoices missing a PO number or approver name.
Return the incomplete invoice to the requester for correction.
Done when every incomplete invoice is routed back with a note.
verify: Check the returned-items log for the flagged invoices.
Pass when every incomplete invoice shows a return entry.

steps.title: Assign a unique tracking number to each invoice
sop: Generate a unique tracking number for each logged invoice.
Record the tracking number in the intake register.
Done when every invoice has a distinct tracking number.
verify: Query the register for duplicate tracking numbers.
Pass when zero duplicate tracking numbers are found.

steps.title: Hand off logged invoices to processing
sop: Confirm every invoice in the batch has a received date and tracking number.
Hand off the intake register batch to the invoice-processing step.
Done when the batch is marked handed off in the register.
verify: Confirm the register batch status reads Handed Off.
Pass when the status is correct for the full batch.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is all disbursed payments pending posting to the AP subledger

generic.Exception handling path: Any mismatch or missing reason code routes back for correction before posting
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Posting is accepted when every entry matches the disbursement record and invoice status updates
generic.Evidence location: AP subledger posting log in the ERP for the processing cycle

steps.title: Open the payment posting screen in the AP subledger
sop: Open the AP subledger posting screen in the ERP.
Select the next disbursed payment awaiting posting.
Done when the posting screen is loaded for the selected payment.
verify: Confirm the loaded payment matches the disbursement record.
Pass when the correct payment is loaded for posting.

steps.title: Post the payment against the correct open invoice
sop: Match the payment to the correct open invoice in the subledger.
Post the payment entry against that invoice.
Done when the payment entry is posted against the matching invoice.
verify: Confirm the posted entry references the correct invoice number.
Pass when the invoice reference matches the disbursement record.

steps.title: Confirm amount, date, and method match the disbursement record
sop: Compare the posted amount, date, and payment method to the disbursement record.
Correct any mismatch before finalizing.
Done when all three fields match the disbursement record.
verify: Re-open the posted entry and compare fields side by side.
Pass when amount, date, and method all match.

steps.title: Verify invoice status changes to Paid
sop: Confirm the invoice status updates from Approved to Paid after posting.
Investigate if the status does not update automatically.
Done when the invoice status field reads Paid.
verify: Refresh the invoice record and check the status field.
Pass when the status reads Paid.

steps.title: Check partial payments carry a reason code
sop: Identify any partial payment posted against the invoice.
Confirm a documented reason code is attached to the partial payment.
Done when every partial payment has a reason code.
verify: Query partial payments for a missing reason code.
Pass when zero partial payments lack a reason code.

steps.title: Confirm the subledger posting batch is complete
sop: Confirm all disbursed payments in the cycle are posted.
Close the posting batch in the ERP.
Done when the posting batch status shows Complete.
verify: Confirm the batch status field reads Complete.
Pass when all payments in the cycle show a posted status.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is the fully approved payment batch ready for treasury release
generic.In-scope period: Current payment run cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Batch file has bank account, amount, and item count populated for every payment
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Released batch total reconciles to the AP payment run summary
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Treasury acceptance confirmation saved with release timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Any rejected or returned item logged with disposition before re-release
generic.Test population: Full-population check of the released batch against the AP summary
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if the batch total and item count match the AP payment run summary exactly
generic.Exception handling path: Any batch rejected by treasury routes back to AP for correction and re-release
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Release is accepted when treasury confirms receipt with a matching total and item count
generic.Evidence location: Treasury payment gateway confirmation log for the batch

steps.title: Confirm the payment batch has completed all required approvals
sop: Open the batch record in the ERP.
Confirm every required approval step shows a completed status.
Done when all required approvals are confirmed complete.
verify: Review the approval history log for the batch.
Pass when every required approval step is marked complete.

steps.title: Transmit the batch file to the treasury payment gateway
sop: Generate the batch file from the ERP.
Transmit the file to the treasury payment gateway.
Done when the transmission confirmation is received.
verify: Check the gateway transmission log for the batch file.
Pass when the transmission log shows a successful send.

steps.title: Verify treasury confirms receipt and acceptance
sop: Review the incoming batch file in the payment gateway.
Confirm acceptance and log the confirmation in the gateway.
Done when the gateway shows an Accepted status for the batch.
verify: Open the gateway batch record and check status.
Pass when the status reads Accepted.

steps.title: Reconcile the released batch total to the AP summary
sop: Pull the AP payment run summary for the batch.
Compare the released batch total and item count to the summary.
Done when the released total and count match the AP summary.
verify: Recompute the comparison after any correction.
Pass when the released batch and AP summary totals match exactly.

steps.title: Resolve any treasury rejection
sop: Review any item rejected by the treasury gateway.
Route the rejected item back to AP for correction.
Done when every rejected item has a logged resolution.
verify: Check the rejection log for open items.
Pass when zero rejected items remain unresolved.

steps.title: Close out the batch release record
sop: Confirm all items in the batch show Accepted or resolved status.
Mark the batch release record as Complete.
Done when the batch release record status reads Complete.
verify: Confirm the batch record status field.
Pass when the status reads Complete with no open rejections.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is all open items on the AP-to-GL reconciliation exception list
generic.In-scope period: Current close period per the close calendar
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each exception record has root cause, correcting entry, and clearance date populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Exception count after correction equals zero unexplained items
generic.Evidence retained with timestamp/version: Correcting entries saved in BlackLine with preparer and clearance timestamp
generic.Exceptions logged with disposition: Each exception logged with root cause category and disposition
generic.Test population: Full-population review of the open exception list for the period
generic.Pass/fail thresholds: Pass if the re-run reconciliation shows zero unexplained variance
generic.Exception handling path: Any exception unresolved by the close deadline escalates to the Controller
generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Exceptions are accepted as cleared when the re-run reconciliation ties out
generic.Evidence location: BlackLine exception log and correcting-entry record for the period

steps.title: Review the AP-to-GL reconciliation exception list
sop: Open the exception list in BlackLine for the current period.
List each open exception with its dollar amount.
Done when the full exception list is compiled for review.
verify: Count the listed exceptions against the BlackLine report.
Pass when the compiled list matches the BlackLine report count.

steps.title: Investigate each exception to root cause
sop: Research each exception (timing difference, miscoding, unmatched payment).
Record the root-cause category against each exception.
Done when every exception has a documented root cause.
verify: Spot-check 5 exceptions for a populated root-cause field.
Pass when all 5 show a documented root cause.

steps.title: Post the correcting entry needed to clear each exception
sop: Prepare the correcting journal entry for each exception.
Post the correcting entry in the ERP.
Done when every exception has a posted correcting entry.
verify: Confirm each correcting entry posted successfully.
Pass when all correcting entries show a posted status.

steps.title: Re-run the reconciliation after corrections
sop: Re-run the AP-to-GL reconciliation in BlackLine after posting corrections.
Confirm the variance drops to zero.
Done when the re-run shows zero unexplained variance.
verify: Review the re-run reconciliation output.
Pass when the variance is zero.

steps.title: Confirm no exception remains open past the close deadline
sop: Check the close calendar deadline for exception clearance.
Confirm every exception is cleared on or before that date.
Done when zero exceptions remain open past the deadline.
verify: Query BlackLine for open exceptions past the deadline.
Pass when the query returns zero open exceptions.

steps.title: Escalate any unresolved exception to the Controller
sop: Identify any exception still open at the close deadline.
Escalate the item to the Controller with root cause and status.
Done when every unresolved exception has a logged escalation.
verify: Check the escalation log against remaining open exceptions.
Pass when every remaining open exception shows a logged escalation.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is all invoices received without a matching purchase order
generic.In-scope period: Invoices received during the current AP processing cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each routed exception has business justification and approver name populated
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Count of routed exceptions matches the count flagged in the AP exception queue

generic.Evidence location: AP exception queue and approval workflow log in the ERP

steps.title: Flag invoices received without a matching purchase order
sop: Run the PO-match check on incoming invoices in Coupa/Ariba.
Route unmatched invoices to the AP exception queue.
Done when every non-PO invoice appears in the exception queue.
verify: Spot-check 5 flagged invoices for an absent PO reference.
Pass when all 5 show no matching PO.

steps.title: Route the non-PO invoice to the cost-center owner
sop: Identify the requesting cost-center owner from the invoice detail.
Route the invoice to that owner for exception approval.
Done when the invoice shows a pending exception-approval task.
verify: Confirm the routed owner matches the cost-center on the invoice.
Pass when the correct cost-center owner is assigned the task.

steps.title: Capture business justification for the missing PO
sop: Require the cost-center owner to enter a business justification.
Confirm the justification is saved with the exception approval.
Done when the exception approval carries a documented justification.
verify: Open the exception record and confirm the justification field is populated.
Pass when a specific business justification is recorded.

steps.title: Confirm the invoice cannot post without exception approval
sop: Attempt to post the non-PO invoice before approval is recorded.
Confirm the ERP blocks posting until approval exists.
Done when the system-enforced block is verified for the tested invoice.
verify: Review the block message for the test invoice.
Pass when posting is blocked until exception approval is recorded.

steps.title: Release the approved exception invoice for payment scheduling
sop: Confirm the exception approval is recorded on the invoice.
Move the invoice into the standard AP approval workflow.
Done when the invoice is queued for payment scheduling.
verify: Confirm the invoice status reflects the exception approval.
Pass when the invoice moves forward in the AP workflow.

steps.title: Escalate exceptions unresolved past the SLA window
sop: Identify non-PO invoices without a decision past the SLA window.
Escalate to the FP&A Manager for resolution.
Done when every SLA-breaching exception has a logged escalation.
verify: Check the escalation log for SLA-breaching invoices.
Pass when every breaching invoice shows a recorded escalation.

generic.Evidence location: Weekly disbursement batch record and remittance advice log in the ERP

steps.title: Generate the weekly disbursement batch
sop: Pull invoices scheduled for payment within terms for the week.
Generate the disbursement batch in the ERP.
Done when the weekly batch is generated with all eligible invoices.
verify: Confirm the batch invoice count matches the scheduled-payment report.
Pass when the counts match exactly.

steps.title: Include remittance advice detail for each vendor payment
sop: Generate remittance advice detail for each payment in the batch.
Attach the remittance detail to the batch file.
Done when every batch item carries remittance advice detail.
verify: Spot-check 5 batch items for attached remittance detail.
Pass when all 5 show complete remittance advice.

steps.title: Run the pre-transmission validation check

verify: Review the validation report for open flags.
Pass when zero unresolved flags remain.

steps.title: Transmit the batch to the payment gateway
sop: Transmit the validated batch file to the payment gateway.
Confirm treasury acceptance of the batch.
Done when treasury confirms disbursement of the batch.
verify: Check the gateway confirmation for the batch.
Pass when the gateway shows a confirmed disbursement.

steps.title: Distribute remittance advice to vendors
sop: Confirm treasury has disbursed the batch.
Distribute remittance advice to each vendor in the batch.
Done when every vendor in the batch has received remittance advice.
verify: Spot-check 5 vendor distribution logs.
Pass when all 5 show a sent remittance advice record.

steps.title: Close the weekly disbursement cycle
sop: Confirm all batch items are disbursed and remittance sent.
Mark the weekly disbursement cycle as Complete.
Done when the cycle status reads Complete for the week.

Pass when the status reads Complete with no open items.

generic.Defined scope/population: Population is all invoices processed and awaiting a scheduled payment date
generic.In-scope period: Invoices processed in the current AP cycle
generic.Required fields populated and valid: Each invoice record has a scheduled payment date populated consistent with terms
generic.Control totals or record counts reconcil: Scheduled-payment report reconciles to the upcoming disbursement batch

generic.Documented acceptance criteria: Scheduling is accepted when every invoice ties to terms and the upcoming batch
generic.Evidence location: Scheduled-payment report in the ERP for the processing cycle

steps.title: Open the scheduled-payment screen for the processed invoice
sop: Open the invoice record in the ERP payment-scheduling screen.
Review the vendor payment terms (e.g. Net 30) on the record.
Done when the terms are confirmed and the scheduling screen is ready.
